﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: cactoos 0.35 -> 0.55.0

## Context

Project `java-api` (by zold-io) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.cactoos:cactoos` from `0.35` to `0.55.0` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/zold-io/java-api/pull/101

## Your Task

The source code is in `/java-api`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and identifying the compilation errors.

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <parent>
    <groupId>com.jcabi</groupId>
    <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
    <version>0.66.0</version>
  </parent>
  <groupId>io.zold</groupId>
  <artifactId>java-api</artifactId>
  <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <name>java-api</name>
  <description>Zold Java API</description>
  <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  <inceptionYear>2017</inceptionYear>
  <organization>
    <name>Zold</name>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  </organization>
  <licenses>
    <license>
      <name>MIT</name>
      <url>https://www.cactoos.org/LICENSE.txt</url>
      <distribution>site</distribution>
    </license>
  </licenses>
  <developers>
    <developer>
      <id>1</id>
      <name>Yegor Bugayenko</name>
      <email>yegor256@gmail.com</email>
      <organization>yegor256.com</organization>
      <organizationUrl>https://www.yegor256.com</organizationUrl>
      <roles>
        <role>Architect</role>
        <role>Developer</role>
      </roles>
      <timezone>-7</timezone>
    </developer>
  </developers>
  <issueManagement>
    <system>GitHub</system>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api/issues</url>
  </issueManagement>
  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:git@github.com:zold-io/java-api.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:zold-io/java-api.git</developerConnection>
    <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  </scm>
  <ciManagement>
    <system>rultor</system>
    <url>https://www.rultor.com/s/java-api</url>
  </ciManagement>
  <distributionManagement>
    <site>
      <id>github-pages</id>
      <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
    </site>
  </distributionManagement>
  <profiles>
    <profile>
      <id>qulice</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>com.qulice</groupId>
            <artifactId>qulice-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>0.17.4</version>
            <configuration>
              <excludes combine.children="append">
                <exclude>checkstyle:/src/site/resources/.*</exclude>
                <exclude>findbugs:.*</exclude>
              </excludes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
  </profiles>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.cactoos</groupId>
      <artifactId>cactoos</artifactId>
      <version>0.55.0</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>javax.json</groupId>
      <artifactId>javax.json-api</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.github.victornoel.eo</groupId>
      <artifactId>eo-envelopes</artifactId>
      <version>0.0.3</version>
      <scope>provided</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.llorllale</groupId>
      <artifactId>cactoos-matchers</artifactId>
      <version>0.11</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>nl.jqno.equalsverifier</groupId>
      <artifactId>equalsverifier</artifactId>
      <version>2.4.8</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.vintage</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-vintage-engine</artifactId>
      <version>5.9.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
      <version>4.13.2</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hamcrest</groupId>
      <artifactId>hamcrest-core</artifactId>
      <version>1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>

   221→            }
   222→        }

   229→        //  it is ignored;

   254→                            () -> incoming.id() == origin.id()
   255→                                && incoming.amount() < 0L,
   256→                            () -> incoming.prefix().equals(origin.prefix())
   257→                        )
   258→                    ).value(),
   259→                    ledger
   260→                ).isEmpty(),
   261→                other.ledger()
   262→            );

   264→                this.id(),
   265→                new Joined<Transaction>(ledger, candidates)
   266→            );

   269→        @Override

   278→                        )

The Maven compilation now succeeds. Here's a summary of the changes made to fix the cactoos 0.35 → 0.55.0 upgrade:

## Changes Made

### API Changes in cactoos 0.55.0

1. **`LengthOf`** - Moved from `org.cactoos.iterable` to `org.cactoos.scalar`, returns `long` via `.value()` instead of `int` via `.intValue()`

2. **`CollectionOf`** - Removed, replaced with `ListOf`

3. **`RandomText`** - Removed, replaced with `TextOf` + `UUID`

4. **`SplitText`** → **`Split`** (in `org.cactoos.text`)

5. **`JoinedText`** → **`Joined`** (in `org.cactoos.text`)

6. **`TrimmedText`** → **`Trimmed`** (in `org.cactoos.text`)

7. **`IoCheckedScalar`** → **`IoChecked`** (in `org.cactoos.scalar`)

8. **`CheckedScalar`**, **`UncheckedScalar`**, **`SolidScalar`**, **`StickyScalar`** - Removed, replaced with `IoChecked` or direct lambdas

9. **`IterableEnvelope`**, **`IteratorEnvelope`** - Removed, replaced with direct `Iterable`/`Iterator` implementations

### Files Modified

- **RtScore.java**: Fixed `LengthOf` import and usage (now returns `long`)
- **Copies.java**: Changed from `IterableEnvelope` to `Iterable`, replaced `CollectionOf` with `ListOf`, rewrote score calculation
- **Remote.java**: Replaced `RandomText` with `TextOf(UUID.randomUUID())`
- **Wallet.java**: Updated imports, replaced `CheckedScalar`/`UncheckedScalar` with `IoChecked`, fixed `SplitText`→`Split`
- **RtNetwork.java**: Changed `IoCheckedScalar` to `IoChecked`
- **TaxBeneficiaries.java**: Changed from `IterableEnvelope` to `Iterable`, fixed `LengthOf` usage
- **WalletsIn.java**: Updated imports, replaced `SolidScalar` with direct lambda, `JoinedText`→`Joined`
- **RtTransaction.java**: Updated all imports, removed `StickyScalar`, fixed `LengthOf.intValue()`→`.value()`
